cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Read the first line of this letter before I do. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

mechanism: A directs how a difficult letter is opened, conceding pace and proximity so B absorbs its first impact without A naming the burden.
confusable: Unlike mere poor reading skill, A requests an emotionally ordinary face and avoids explaining delay; borrowed authority adapts the reading procedure to retain B help.
comparison: Quiet shared letter reading differs from outsourcing an emotionally loaded cancellation call.
seedUse: Use D97-b first line/face/one line/page/finger and S02-b method adapting to the willing helper.
